text:
jenna_csm: Heads-up — BlueForge pilot demo Thu 10:00 SGT. They need APAC egress peering + IP allowlist + temporary rate-limit lift (target 120 rps) for ~3h starting at 09:30 SGT. Demo is customer-facing.

sam_eng: Do we have their CIDRs? what's current QPS? any sustained burst pattern?

jenna_csm: they sent CIDRs and a preview load. Current production QPS is 30, test spikes to ~100 for 5–10m. CIDRs: 34.120.32.0/28 and 34.120.32.16/28. Purpose: live demo hitting chat endpoints.

alan_infra: ok can do temporary override in routing + allowlist. I'll create a scoped policy. Will need ticket and approval for cross-region peering.

ops_bot: Ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4129 — summary "BlueForge APAC demo: temp qps increase + CIDR allowlist". Assignee: alan_infra.

leo_sre: Recommend we set prefix KV cache to enabled for that route and bump worker concurrency to avoid latency spikes. I'll add a monitoring runbook.

alan_infra: Draft policy below — can someone review? If approved I'll apply and tag auto-revoke in 3h.

```yaml
rate_limit_override:
  customer: "blueforge"
  region: "ap-southeast-1"
  qps: 120
  duration_seconds: 10800
  allowlist_cidrs:
    - "34.120.32.0/28"
    - "34.120.32.16/28"
  note: "Temp demo lift - auto-revoke after 3h"
```

karen_csm: Noted — BlueForge is flagged as "at-risk" for renewal (low usage). This demo is critical for converting pilot to paid. Please mark this as high priority.

sam_eng: Reviewed. No schema issues. Two checks before apply: traffic shaping rule exists for route `/v1/generate` and fallback model set (to limit cost).

alan_infra: Applied temporary override at 2812345699. Auto-revoke scheduled. Policy ID: tmp-APAC-blueforge-2026-03-23.

ops_bot: Policy applied and scheduled for removal in 3h. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/policies/tmp-APAC-blueforge-2026-03-23

leo_sre: Monitoring set — dashboards: latency, 5xx, token cost. I'll post alerts if 95th p99 > 400ms.

jenna_csm: Thanks all. I'll join the demo and collect feedback. Please ping if anything flares. :pray: 

karen_csm: Capture follow-up: add note to renewal playbook that success of demo -> outreach for 6mo discounted committed capacity.

jenna_csm: Will do — closing thread once auto-revoke completes and post-demo notes attached to CS-4129.
